definition_used: Any question, controversy or dispute about authorship and/or affiliation, except for false/forged authorship or false/forged affiliation. False/forged authorship or false/forged affiliation are covered under their own reasons.
semantic_rationale: The definition explicitly covers disputes about authorship/affiliation, directly aligning with the attribution_authorship_disclosure_integrity category. The problem object is authorship_affiliation, process signal is authorship_publication_process, and actor context is author, as these are inherent to authorship concerns.
